# Harness adapters

Each subdirectory adapts one coding-agent harness to the agent review
pipeline (see `docs/development/tools/agent-review.md`). All files here are
read from the workflow's own commit, never from the pull request.

| File         | Contract                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| ------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `install.sh` | `install.sh <prefix>`. Runs in the secretless `prepare` job. Installs an **exact** version with integrity checks (npm: `npm ci` against a committed `package-lock.json`; binaries: release URL plus SHA-256) into `<prefix>`, and writes the version to `<prefix>/VERSION`. The prefix is unpacked to `/opt/agent-review/harness/<name>` (read-only) and must run from there without network access.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `run.sh`     | Runs inside the sandbox from the PR checkout, under `timeout`. Environment: `PROMPT_FILE`, `REPO_DIR`, `OUT_DIR`, `CONTEXT_DIR`, `MODEL`, `HARNESS_PREFIX`, `PR_NUMBER`, and AWF's `AWF_API_PROXY_OPENAI_URL` / `AWF_API_PROXY_ANTHROPIC_URL`. Keeps its configuration in a scratch home under `$TMPDIR` (a directory in the workspace), built from environment variables only; disables auto-update, telemetry, sharing and remote model catalogues; runs headless and writes `$OUT_DIR/review.md`. Exit codes: 0 review written, 2 ran but no review, anything else a failure. **Return 2, not 0, when the harness exits 0 without a real answer** (a step cap, a stall detector or a tool-call-only last turn can all do that): `run-review` posts whatever `review.md` holds after exit 0. Harness output goes to files in `$OUT_DIR`, which are not collected; print diagnostics only through `diag` in `common.sh`, which prefixes every line so that the harness's output cannot be read as a workflow command. |
| `wire`       | One line: `openai-chat`, `anthropic-messages` or `none`. Selects the variable the inference key is passed in, and so AWF's listener. Clients use the listener origin: OpenAI chat clients that append only `/chat/completions` (opencode, memdoor, Pi's `openai-completions`) need `$AWF_API_PROXY_OPENAI_URL/v1`; Anthropic clients that append `/v1/messages` need `$AWF_API_PROXY_ANTHROPIC_URL` as is. Do not use `anthropic-messages` with AWF v0.29.12: setting `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` makes its entrypoint fail when the home directory is read-only (`filesystem.allowWrite`); an Anthropic client can use `$AWF_API_PROXY_OPENAI_URL` instead, since the OpenAI listener forwards `/v1/messages` with a Bearer token.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `README.md`  | Pinned version, how to upgrade it, the paths it reads as instructions or configuration (add them to `../instruction-files.txt`), and any outbound calls it tries to make.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |

The harness name must also be added to the `workflow_dispatch` choice and to
the `case` in the `Authorize` step of `.github/workflows/agent-review.yml`.

`common.sh` holds the helpers the adapters share: the scratch `HOME`, `NO_PROXY` for loopback and the listeners, and bounded diagnostics.

| Harness               | Version  | Wire          | Ignores the repository's configuration with                     | Turn cap             |
| --------------------- | -------- | ------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------- |
| [opencode](opencode/) | 2.2.7    | `openai-chat` | `OPENCODE_DISABLE_PROJECT_CONFIG=1`                             | 35 steps, then AWF's |
| [memdoor](memdoor/)   | v1.827.0 | `openai-chat` | nothing (`run-review` resets `AGENTS.md`); `skill` tool guarded | AWF's only           |
| [pi](pi/)             | 1.5.2    | `openai-chat` | `--no-approve --no-context-files`                               | AWF's only           |

`stub` makes no model call and writes a fixed review with hostile content
(an @mention, HTML comments imitating the comment marker, and optional
padding); it tests the pipeline without any secret.
